_: Off-season blurbs for the Teams view's form block (app.js renderTeamForm): shown before a season starts and once one is well over. Plain text, one per team slug. Edit freely — nothing generates this file.
bears: The Bears' season runs September to January at Soldier Field, with the playoffs beyond that; flex-week kickoffs fill in above as the league confirms them.
cubs: Spring training opens in Mesa in February and the regular season in late March at Wrigley Field; the schedule above fills in once MLB publishes it.
whitesox: Spring training opens in Glendale in February and the regular season in late March at Rate Field; the schedule above fills in once MLB publishes it.
bulls: The Bulls' season runs late October to April at the United Center, 41 home dates, with the play-in and the playoffs beyond that.
blackhawks: The Blackhawks' season runs October to April at the United Center, 41 home dates, with the playoffs beyond that for the top eight in the Western Conference.
fire: The Fire's MLS season runs late February to October at Soldier Field, 17 home matches, with the Cup playoffs through early December.
sky: The Sky's WNBA season runs May to September at Wintrust Arena, with the playoffs beyond that; the schedule arrives over the winter.
stars: The Stars' NWSL season runs March to November at SeatGeek Stadium in Bridgeview, with the playoffs beyond that; the fixture list arrives over the winter.
